integrity: Complete analytic proof and a directly executable numerical cross-check are included; simulations corroborate but do not prove infinite sign oscillations. Originality may be implicitly covered by broader renewal or phase-type covariance literature.
scientific_limitations: Integer Erlang clock shapes, free Brownian particles, independent particle noise, exact collective resets, stationary two-time cross-particle squared-position covariance; exponentially vanishing large-lag extrema. General real Gamma shapes and nonlinear interacting systems not addressed.
title: A sharp five-stage onset of temporal energy anticorrelation under collective renewal resetting
